scenario.title: An older procedure for a different revision
scenario.ticket: Lee: My underside label says Vale L4 Air revision B. I need to enter wireless pairing mode. An older leaflet says to hold the wireless button for 8 seconds. Is that right for my printer? I do not want to erase its network settings.

documents.title: Revision A wireless leaflet
documents.text: For L4 Air revision A only, hold the wireless button for 8 seconds until amber to enter pairing mode. Do not apply this procedure to other revisions.

documents.title: Revision B correction and priority
documents.text: The L4 Air revision B supports Wi-Fi. For revision B, this correction supersedes the revision A leaflet. Hold the wireless button for 3 seconds until cyan, then release to enter pairing mode. Holding it for 8 seconds on revision B erases network settings; do not use the revision A timing.

documents.title: Pairing support scope
documents.text: When revision B is confirmed, explain the applicable pairing procedure and the consequence of the old timing. This ticket requests advice only; do not open a handoff. Do not promise a purchase, return, refund, or exchange.
